name: mcelog

error_log.rationale: mcelog writes machine-check error records to this host log.

budget.rationale: Regenerable storage budget measured and governed on 2026-08-05; age is the reclaim ceiling.

storage.rationale: mcelog owns a host log on Linux; the log is diagnostic and regenerable.

description: Machine Check Exception logger — companion to rasdaemon for AMD/Intel hardware error capture; logs to /var/log/mcelog
installHint: Install mcelog via your package manager. On modern AMD systems mcelog is often superseded by rasdaemon — that is acceptable; this tool reports ExecutionAlreadyPresent in that case.
